description:
Job Description:- 
 At least 7 years of experienc e in Business Process Consulting, problem definition, Architecture/Design /Detailing of Processes 
 Experience in full stack Java Developers / Architects with one or more of the following skillsets: 
 In-depth understanding of the cloud domain with experience in AWS / Azure / VMWare / Microsoft cloud management tools 
 In-depth understanding of the infrastructure Operations domain with experience in open source orchestration tools and scripting languages ( shell/ perl/ python/ powershell ) 
 Experience with software configuration management tools like Chef / Puppet 
 Experience with big data technologies like Hadoop / Hbase / Spark / Kafka / Hive etc 
 Strong understanding of Machine Learning and some experience with using ML libraries 
 Experience and desire to work in a management consulting environment that requires regular travel 
 

 Basic Qualifications :- 
 Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education. 
 At least 7 years of experience in IT 
 
 **  U.S. citizens and those authorized to work in the U.S. are encouraged to apply .  We are unable to sponsor at this time. 
 Note:- 
 This is a Fulltime job for you
 Only US Citizen, Green Card Holder, TN Visa, GC-EAD ,  H4-EAD & L2-EAD can apply. 
 No OPT-EAD & H1B Consultants please.
 
 Please mention your  Visa Status  in your  email   or  resume .
